corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the central vertical stem of ቀ, reading the classical Ge'ez theological phrase 'ብእሴ ጸድቀ' (referring to Christ's humanity which was justified/sanctified).
In the printed column, line 10 ends with 'እ' and 'ንተ' begins line 11.
Line 11 clearly begins with 'ንተ' completing 'እንተ' from the end of line 10.
Both visually on the page (first-order ደ without a right-side foot serif) and grammatically in Amharic ('ረቂቅ መለኮት እንደሆነ'), the character is ደ.
The printed glyph has the right-side mid-stroke of 2nd-order ሁ ('ሁኖ'), consistent with the archaic Andemta orthography throughout this page.
